numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Support-function atom value computation is inaccurate due to a hardcoded internal solve call using SCS with eps=1e-6, yielding an observed error of about 1.5707e-06 in the failing test (later reduced to 1.7e-10 when eps is set to 1e-8).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The computed support-function value should match the analytic support-function value within the test's asserted tolerance; the issue also states that solving the dual standalone matches to 1.5e-13 and the conic lift primal matches to 1.6260907142 vs analytic 1.6260907190 (error 4.8e-09), so only the internal solve tolerance limits the returned value.
trigger_conditions: Computing support-function atom values via SuppFuncAtom._value_impl where it calls prob.solve with solver='SCS' and eps=1e-6 hardcoded
Using a setup where the test asserts abs(actual - expected) <= 1e-6; observed error 1.5707e-06 breaks that bound
Using SCS versions where termination behavior differs slightly; described as SCS 3.3.1 pushing latent inaccuracies over the test threshold

oracle_clues: The tests assert abs(actual - expected) <= 1e-6 and observed abs(actual - expected) was 1.5707e-06.

Passage states conic lift is correct (1.6260907142 vs analytic 1.6260907190, error 4.8e-09) and dual in suppfunc_canon is correct (hand optimum ||y|| + a'y; standalone dual solves match to 1.5e-13), so the discrepancy is attributed to the hardcoded internal solve tolerance.
When the internal solve tolerance is tightened to eps=1e-8, the error drops to 1.7e-10.

numerical_characteristics.tolerance: abs(actual - expected) <= 1e-6 (observed 1.5707e-06); at eps=1e-8 error drops to 1.7e-10; tests assert to 5 decimal places
category_specific_evidence: ppFuncAtom._value_impl in cvxpy/atoms/suppfunc.py hardcoded prob.solve(solver='SCS', eps=1e-6), capping accuracy at ~1e-6
A support-function evaluation violated the test bound: assertLessEqual(abs(actual - expected), 1e-6), observed 1.5707e-06
Support-function evaluation was inaccurate for all support functions; error reduced when using eps=1e-8 (from 1.5707e-06 to 1.7e-10)

Localisation: conic lift correct (primal over lifted (A,b,K) gives 1.6260907142 vs analytic 1.6260907190, error 4.8e-09) and dual in suppfunc_canon correct (hand optimum ||y|| + a'y matches to 1.5e-13); only the internal hardcoded solve tolerance remained
SE problem solve tolerance mismatch also showed up as: est_vector2norm | 1.5706827991568417e-06 not <= 1e-06
CI/test strictness issue: tests assert to 5 decimal places, which can fail under SCS default accuracy guarantees; one run had scs 3.3.1 with 6 failed / 2628 passed / 872 skipped / 52 subtests passed
reproduction_risks: Reproduction outcomes may depend on the installed SCS version (e.g., failure observed with scs 3.3.1) because SCS accuracy guarantees differ across versions
Solver-specific tolerances/assumptions: the failing bound is tied to a hardcoded internal eps=1e-6 for the support-function evaluation; reproducing requires the same (or compare against) eps behavior
Switching solver (e.g., to CLARABEL) can avoid the SCS-specific tolerance issue, so reproducing the bug likely requires using the hardcoded SCS path
If replication environment uses the #3518 fix or equivalent (using CLARABEL for support-function numerical evaluation), the numerical violation may no longer occur
